title: Modern NLP and Transformer Models knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which practice is most closely aligned with “Modern NLP and Transformer Models” and its subtopic “Attention fundamentals”?
options: Choose the most complex available method even when a simpler baseline answers the question.
Treat a strong result on the examples used to tune the method as proof it will generalize.
Skip input checks whenever the first output appears plausible.
Use attention fundamentals in service of the stated question, then check evidence and assumptions.
questions.answer_key: Use attention fundamentals in service of the stated question, then check evidence and assumptions.
questions.explanation: The curriculum connects modern nlp and transformer models with attention fundamentals. Apply the relevant method to a defined question and check the evidence and assumptions instead of overgeneralizing from one example.

questions.prompt: Before you rely on a result related to “Modern NLP and Transformer Models”, what is the strongest next step?
options: Check input quality and units, compare with an expected or baseline result, and record limitations.
Tune decisions against the final test set until the score reaches the desired level.
Assume the same method will work across all populations, locations, and time periods.
Check only whether the code completed without an error.
questions.answer_key: Check input quality and units, compare with an expected or baseline result, and record limitations.
questions.explanation: Validate input quality and units, compare the result to an appropriate expectation or baseline, and record the limits. This is particularly important when working with transformer architecture overview.

questions.prompt: A small example of “Modern NLP and Transformer Models” works as expected. What does that establish?
options: It proves a causal mechanism for every population and time period.
Treat success as limited evidence; check representative cases, uncertainty, and real-world risks before relying on it.
It guarantees fairness, privacy, security, and accuracy without a separate review.
It removes the need for documentation, testing, or monitoring.
questions.answer_key: Treat success as limited evidence; check representative cases, uncertainty, and real-world risks before relying on it.
questions.explanation: A small example supports only a limited claim under its tested conditions. Generalization requires representative evidence, uncertainty analysis where relevant, and review of real-world risks.
